description: Search NodajiMarket's curated catalogue of Korean handcrafted goods and artworks by named artists. Artworks marked coa ship with an artist-signed certificate of authenticity. Prices are in USD (integer cents); for the US and Canada the checkout total is DDP — duties and import taxes included, nothing more to pay on delivery; other destinations ship DAP (the buyer pays duties and taxes on delivery) — get_landed_cost returns incoterm per destination. Returns up to 20 products with price, artist, availability and lead time, plus next_cursor when there are more. Payment is completed by a human in a browser via a Stripe Checkout link (see nodajimarket_create_checkout); no tool here takes payment.

category.description: Exact category id, e.g. craft, ink_painting, calligraphy

max_price_usd.description: Upper bound on item price in US dollars

query.description: Free-text keywords (Korean or English): material, technique, artist, subject

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

name: nodajimarket_search_products
title: Search NodajiMarket products
